pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
The Guide's Pickaxe is the exclusive tool of the Guide Doll.

• Durability 2031, mining speed 9.0, enchantability 15
• +6 attack damage, 1.2 attack speed
• Repairable with iron ingots on an anvil

Smooth stepping
• While held in the main or off hand, the player climbs one-block steps smoothly, with no jumping required

pages.title: Guide Doll Bonus
pages.text:
These exclusive effects apply only while a Guide Doll holds and uses it in its MAIN hand (in its inventory, or in the off hand, they do not apply):

• Melee weapon: a Guide Doll treats it as a melee weapon, so it can fight in Melee mode
• Tunnel drill upgrade: when a Guide Doll tunnels while holding this pickaxe in its main hand, the tunnel cross-section grows from 1×2 to 3×3 — 9 blocks dug per cycle — and the nearby-ore scan range expands as well
• Ignores falling blocks: in 3×3 mode it no longer stops for gravel or sand ahead (lava and water still stop it)

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: 2 iron ingots flanking 1 lapis lazuli form the head; 2 redstone form the handle.
